title: Quetta Acquisition Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-10
summary: Quetta Acquisition Corporation, a SPAC listed on Nasdaq Global Market (tickers: QETAU, QETA, QETAR), received a delisting notice on April 6, 2026 due to failure to meet the minimum Market Value of Listed Securities requirement of $50,000,000 and minimum holder requirements. The company intends to request a hearing before a Nasdaq Hearings Panel by April 13, 2026.
key_points: Company received Nasdaq delisting determination on April 6, 2026
Primary reason: failure to meet Nasdaq Listing Rule 5450(b)(2)(A) MVLS requirement of $50,000,000
Secondary independent reason: failure to meet minimum 400 total holders requirement under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5450(a)(2)
180-day compliance period (expired March 2, 2026) was provided to regain compliance
Company applied to transfer to Nasdaq Capital Market on February 23, 2026 but did not qualify (failed 300 public holder minimum)
Company intends to request hearing before Nasdaq Hearings Panel by April 13, 2026
